name: File Manager
description: Browse, upload and download files over terminal handles, S3 and FTP.

apps.title: File Manager
apps.description: Browse and manage files over terminal sources and the space's S3/FTP connections.

actions.label: Pack into zip
actions.description: Pack files and folders of a terminal into a new zip archive, folders with everything in them. The archive gets a free name: the one asked for, or one made from the single item's name ("Archive.zip" for several), with " 2", " 3"… added when it is taken; nothing is overwritten. The terminal needs no zip tool. Answers the archive's path and name, and how many files, folders and bytes went in. A failure leaves no archive behind.

paths.description: Absolute paths of the files and folders to pack; no two with the same name

target.description: Absolute path of the folder the archive goes into. Default: the first path's folder

name.description: The archive's file name. Default: from the items

actions.label: Unpack zip
actions.description: Unpack a zip archive on a terminal into a new folder named after it (a free name, " 2" and on when taken), so nothing already there is overwritten. The terminal needs no unzip tool. An archive with an entry that would land outside that folder (".." or an absolute path) is refused before anything is written. Symbolic links and macOS's __MACOSX metadata are left out and counted. Answers the folder's path and name, and how many files, folders and bytes came out. A failure removes the folder.

target.description: Absolute path of the folder the new folder goes into. Default: the archive's folder
